summary: Atlassian is australian enterprise software company, founded in 2002. Type: listed company. About 4,907 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 24 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about acquisitions; 3 about growth or hiring.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Australian maker of Jira, Confluence and Trello; all 24 roles here are Amsterdam sales jobs in English, with a choice of office, home or both.

culture.text: Staff can choose to work in an office, from home or a mix of both.
Mostly a software crowd: staff studied computer science, IT and software engineering, often at UNSW, Sydney or UC Berkeley.

open.text: Atlassian B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Some roles say you must already live in the UK, Germany or the Netherlands, with no relocation support.

growth.text: Grew from 1,760 staff in 2016 to 8,179 in 2022; LinkedIn now lists about 16,857.
Its remaining performance obligations rose 44% to US$4.8 billion.
Expanded its partnership with OpenAI, including a spending commitment.

worth_knowing.text: Identity verification, possibly using biometric data, is a condition of employment to prevent hiring fraud.
Warned customers to urgently patch a critical file-access flaw in its Data Center products.
